synth.executive:
Crank 3 synthesis at HEAD 78c6f524 (v5.65.2; the assignment's 918a58b7 is 3 commits back — a second CTO crank committed and released during the lanes' run; recipe/panel/bridge surfaces are byte-identical across that gap, so verdicts transfer). Seven lanes filed 63 findings; refuters killed 2 and re-tiered 20. 24 refuter-'missed' items entered, several of them stronger than the lane finding they corrected.

Two things break release truth. (1) README.md:253 — the line the in-range B8 'release truth' commit rewrote — still says scene mutations are 'undo-wrapped and reversible' and that the safety set 'rides the audited /mcp bridge path', while README.md:481 says that phrasing 'was overstated' and CLAUDE.md 1.8 says 'say undoable, never reversed'; the /mcp server .mcp.json actually registers (mcp_server.py) has zero bridge references and stamps consent_verified=False. (2) v5.64.0 and v5.65.0 were tagged on commits whose CI concluded failure, v5.65.2 was tagged with its run still in_progress, and B1's closure predicate reads the branch head instead of the tagged commit, so it printed green over both.

The recurring shape across lanes is a green gate over an unmeasured surface: the emitted-node-type audit scans only python/synapse/routing and only node types, so ten live-refuted parms and four phantom node types ship under a passing test; audit_panel.py --strict exits 0 when the live tier is SKIPPED; the headless scout resolves the H21 symbol table and returns exists_in_runtime=false for real H22 symbols in the channel CLAUDE.md 15 tells the model means 'do not emit'; RSI's P1 completeness predicate cannot see forge/ or harness/; the CTO loop itself has no rule forcing a CONFIRMED finding into the backlog, and dropped one 24h ago that this run paid to re-derive.

Unsettled (no open_questions field in this schema): whether gate-less bridge is ratified posture or an unclosed critical from two prior reviews; whether the 13-Sept Solaris demo date still stands; whether harness/cto should be registered as an RSI loop; whether hython-tier 110 failed/771 errors is real or stale-environment noise (nobody has re-run it since 2026-08-02); whether R.3's prescribed fix (gate the pypanel module purge) is acceptable given the purge is the panel's only reload path. Backlog below = 10 new findings + 17 still-open SWEEP ids carried at their original ids.
synth.panel_verdict: 'The panel design is stagnant / not updating' is REFUTED on both readings and the DESIGN lane proved it: tokens/qss/rhythm all changed 2026-09-05 alongside the widgets, census went 107 spacing / 106 inline / 135 raw hex -> 12 / 1 / 0, all seven pd/* branches merged with Joe's word, G3 strict green under hython 22.0.400 offscreen, and the live probe resolves tokens to the master tree at SIGNAL #8FB3D9 with ~/.synapse/design NOT on sys.path. The lane's ratchet finding (DSN-04) was itself refuted — tests/test_panel_rhythm_owner.py:115-131 already walks the real tree with exact=True. What is actually wrong with the panel: (a) the .pypanel module purge at houdini/python_panels/synapse_panel.pypanel:36-38 is classified a production defect by the repo's own R.3 check (harness/verify/checks.py:2091-2118, ok=False on master) and is simultaneously the only path by which edits reach a running Houdini — nobody has reconciled the fix with the symptom; (b) audit_panel.py --strict returns 0 when it skips the live tier and prints a remedy naming Houdini 21.0.671, which is not installed; (c) a dead legacy chat surface (panel/synapse_chat.pypanel + chat_panel.py + python/synapse/ui/) still ships, zero importers, and is the only file re-arming the ~/.synapse/design cyan side channel; (d) fourteen design predicates remain open or UNKNOWN, all gate=joe. The J1 model token can also sit green forever after bridge loss — nothing writes 'disconnected' — while its own docstring says it 'is never a stale green'.
synth.two_day_work_verdict: 127 commits / 477 files / 126,762 insertions in range bought: panel typography and rhythm convergence (51 files, 3,664 insertions), the CTO review harness itself, and ten B-item repairs. Product code outside the panel moved 329 lines across 11 files — 0.26% of insertions, 171 of them a JSON data file. Five of 127 commits touched Solaris v3 / recipes, none advancing an acceptance gate; harness/solaris_v3/GATES.json is still 19/19 NOT_RUN with a 13-Sept demo target and RecipeHandlerMixin still absent from the SynapseHandler MRO. The review loop is genuinely working — crank 2 caught and withdrew its own false B6 closure, restored 8 truncated predicates and de-deafened 4 probes, which is the strongest self-correction evidence in the repo. But the same crank published v5.65.2 on an unfinished CI run and 8 of 9 closed B-items still carry byte-identical boilerplate closure_evidence that check_backlog.py's 25-char length test cannot see through. Net: the loop improved its own instruments and shipped nothing to the artist. RSI registry has gained zero rungs in 36 days; its SPEC pre-named that as the likely failure mode.
synth.recipes_verdict: FIVE recipe homes, ZERO executable. (1) python/synapse/routing/recipes/ — 62 recipes, listed by synapse_list_recipes (handlers.py:1675), but the only production TieredRouter (handlers.py:1711) is built with no command_fn, so router.py:410 forces executed=False and every tier is proposal-only by construction; its sole route_chat caller is the unregistered legacy chat_panel.py. (2) panel/recipe_book.py — 21 recipes, parse_recipe_command/build_recipe_messages lost every non-test caller when the pypanel monolith collapsed 2026-06-01; the palette still advertises /recipes and sends prose, not the graph. (3) panel/apex_recipes.py — 8 recipes, same. (4) routing/hda_recipes.py — 5, reachable only from (2)'s dead controller. (5) python/synapse/recipes/ Solaris v3 — ~4,230 LOC still growing, mixin unregistered, synapse_run_recipe absent from TOOL_DEFS, ReceiptStore.append has no non-test caller, golden_reference PENDING_HUMAN, 19/19 gates NOT_RUN. Correctness: live H22.0.400 probes refute ten parms across three routing files (rbdmaterialfracture numpieces, assemble create_packed, rbdconstraintproperties type/strength, oceanspectrum speed/chop, heightfield_noise height/noisefreq/octaves, karmarendersettings specularlimit) and four node types in the panel homes (usdrop, uvtexture, bonegenerator phantom; twist and mountain deprecated). The RBD recipe dies on its FIRST parm set. scripts/extract_emitted_node_types.py --check exits 0 through all of it: _RECIPE_ROOT is python/synapse/routing (panel/ invisible), it audits node types not parms, and it keys deprecation on the literal so 'mountain' scores clean while createNode('mountain') returns the deprecated mountain::2.0. Note the corrected fix: the catalog cannot be the parm authority (it dumps parmTuples only — a naive catalog-literal audit false-positives at 76%); a runtime probe must be, exactly as the dir() symbol table became the authority for hou.*. Meanwhile a live, dispatched, runtime-validating path already ships and no recipe home uses it: synapse_propose_graph / synapse_instantiate_graph (GraphSynthHandlerMixin IS in the MRO; graph_validator.py:102,121 checks node types and parms against the live runtime and would have rejected every phantom above).

lane_scores.one_line: 9/10 held plus one upgrade; correctly identified that the registered /mcp server is bridge-less, but 3 line cites drifted and its release snapshot went stale inside the hour.

Refuted the stagnation premise cleanly with live evidence, then rated the .pypanel module purge 'info / coverage is correct' while the repo's own R.3 check calls those exact lines a production defect; one finding fully refuted.

Found the real phantom-parm class and the README contradiction, but 2 of its 3 lead phantoms were refuted by live probe and its prescribed catalog-based gate would false-positive 76%; the refuter's probe found 10 more.
All 10 survived and 4 correctly downgraded; strongest CI and hygiene evidence, but it read doctor's code without running it and missed the H21-symbol-table fallback its own probe surfaced.

The schedule frame on Solaris and the tag-vs-branch CI blindness are the two most useful findings in the run; it then re-ran B4 on one clause of two and called it green - the same partial-predicate error it charges the sweep with.
10/10 survived, one upgraded; the only lane that live-probed every claim, and its five-home inventory is the sharpest artifact of the crank - it just missed that no command channel exists at all.

Thorough registry work but severity inflated across the board (6 downgrades, 1 refuted on an in-flight run mistaken for a dormant half); the refuter found the real defect - the CTO loop drops CONFIRMED findings.
